top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Pakistan sign defense pact amid regional war
top_signals.summary: Riyadh is looking to strengthen its security ties against the backdrop of war between the U.S. and Iran, which has drawn in surrounding nations and disrupted shipping.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Partly Resumes Operations in Mexico’s Avocado State Michoacan
top_signals.summary: The US will partially resume operations in Mexico’s top avocado-producing state, days after security concerns prompted a halt that disrupted inspections for exports.
